gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-gf-bhutuka-expande: Hand-drawn warmth runs through Hachi Maru Pop, its letters spread out in a relaxed, inviting way. But BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif with curvy letters, slows the eye to a leisurely walk, so give it generous size.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-gf-hepta-slab: Relaxed and inviting, Hachi Maru Pop sprawls with a hand-drawn feel while Hepta Slab, a dignified serif, follows below. Its open counters let long paragraphs breathe, line after line.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-gf-orbit: Loose and hand-drawn, Hachi Maru Pop stretches its spacing out and feels relaxed and inviting. And Orbit, a sans with detached characters and rope-like stems, gives it a steady partner on the page.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-gf-padyakke-expand: Inviting and hand-drawn, Hachi Maru Pop spreads its letters out with an easy, relaxed manner. Padyakke Expanded One carries the authority, with pitcher-wide c's and bowls of uniform wall, while the heading greets you.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-gf-stint-ultra-exp: Pure handwritten ease: Hachi Maru Pop stretches its spacing and keeps every e open toward the right. Yet Stint Ultra Expanded, a serif with pipe-cleaner letterforms floating apart, brings the traditional authority underneath.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-gf-syncopate: Syncopate lays its letters out like rungs on a rope ladder. What stands out is the tension between that technical-pen precision and the relaxed, hand-drawn looseness of Hachi Maru Pop.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-montserrat: Hachi Maru Pop brings a hand-drawn, stretched-out looseness, with a moderate lowercase height. Montserrat rises higher with oversized a counters and a gliding, geometric line, so the two never crowd each other.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-satoshi: Approachable and tall in the lowercase, Satoshi sits under the hand-drawn Hachi Maru Pop heading. Satoshi keeps its wide e from ever squeezing shut, so paragraph after paragraph unfolds without strain.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-switzer: Switzer draws tubular, wire-like letters with a tall waist line. If Hachi Maru Pop is made small, its stretched-out, hand-drawn spacing loses its relaxed charm next to the sans below.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-work-sans: Hachi Maru Pop is best at warmth, with hand-drawn, stretched-out letters and an inviting, relaxed feel. But Work Sans handles the contemporary side, its high mean line and sturdy joins keeping text tidy.
